Welcome to Best V Care Animal Hospital,  www.bestvcare.com
Your trusted veterinary clinic in Wariyapola, North Western Province, Sri Lanka. 🐾

We provide a full range of professional pet care services including:

🩺OPD Treatments & Consultations

💉Vaccinations

🚑Pet Surgeries & Emergency Care

🧪Veterinary Laboratory & Ultrasound Scanning

💊In-house Pet Pharmacy  

🛁Pet Grooming

🏥Pet Shop with high-quality supplies

🩺Post Mortem Examinations

Our experienced veterinary team 👩‍⚕️👨‍⚕️ is dedicated to ensuring your pets receive the best care in a modern, friendly, and compassionate environment.

📍 Visit us in, No 26 city reach, Wariyapola, Sri Lanka.
📞 Call 037-22 70 677, WhatsApp 077- 32 70 677 us to book appointments or visit https://bestvcare.com/appointment/
📆 Open 7 Days | For Dogs, Cats, Puppies,Kittens &  more.. 🐶🐱

Subscribe to stay updated with pet care tips, case studies, and behind-the-scenes videos from our hospital! 🐶🐱
